instruction: Candid street photograph, full-length shot. On an urban sidewalk during the day, the woman in the white halter maxi dress (R2) on the left and the person in the light blue denim jacket (R1) on the right run joyfully hand-in-hand. The woman (R2) smiles and looks ahead, while the person in the denim jacket (R1) smiles warmly at her. They hold hands in the center as they run forward. The background shows a soft-focus city street with trees. Soft, natural daylight illuminates the scene, creating a bright and cheerful atmosphere.
